name: Lighting layers
definition: Light comes from separate layers with separate jobs: ambient light for the whole space, task light for work, accent light for the focal point. In photography the same split is key, fill and accent light.

sources.title: IES Lighting Handbook, 10th edition (Illuminating Engineering Society, 2011)
